claude_orchestration.enabled.title: Enabled
claude_orchestration.enabled.x-description: Master toggle for the Claude orchestration capability. Default-off + BETA: the Workflow-tool execution backend and the ultraplan plan-offload surface are inert unless this is true. When false, loop behaviour is byte-identical to a non-Claude runtime (inline/manual dispatch).

claude_orchestration.execution_backend.title: Execution Backend
claude_orchestration.execution_backend.x-description: Which execute-phase dispatch backend to use when the capability is enabled. 'auto' (default) activates the Workflow backend only when the runtime is Claude AND the Workflow tool is detected AND the Agent SDK meets claude_orchestration.min_agent_sdk_version; otherwise it falls back to inline. 'workflow' forces the Workflow backend when the tool is present AND the Agent SDK meets the floor (still fails closed to inline if the tool is absent or the SDK is too old — the floor applies in both modes). 'inline' forces today's manual one-agent-per-message dispatch regardless of tool availability.

claude_orchestration.min_agent_sdk_versi.title: Min Agent Sdk Version
claude_orchestration.min_agent_sdk_versi.x-description: Minimum Agent SDK version required to activate the Workflow backend under execution_backend='auto'. Defaults to 0.3.149 (the release that introduced the Workflow tool). Raise to pin a higher floor; the detection seam fails closed to inline for any runtime reporting an older or unknown version.

mempalace.memory_mode.title: Memory Mode
mempalace.memory_mode.x-description: How MemPalace relates to GSD native memory during recall/capture. 'augment' (default): the palace is an additive layer alongside .planning/graphs/ — native memory stays authoritative. 'kg_backend': knowledge-graph queries resolve against the palace's temporal KG as the primary source, with .planning/graphs/ as fallback. 'replace': recall resolves through the palace as the source of truth, native memory as fallback. Every mode stays onError:skip and default-resilient — an unreachable palace degrades to native memory, and GSD keeps writing .planning/graphs/ so no memory is lost. Cross-mode migration of existing .planning/graphs/ into the palace is a separate, not-yet-implemented concern.

augment.x-description: Add MemPalace recall on top of normal project context without replacing the existing context sources.

kg_backend.x-description: Use the temporal knowledge-graph backend as the primary memory source for MemPalace recall.

replace.x-description: Replace the normal memory injection path with MemPalace recall output instead of appending it.

workflow.plan_drift_precheck.x-description: Enable the non-blocking codebase drift pre-check at plan:pre, before /gsd:plan-phase spawns the planner. When enabled, a stale STRUCTURE.md (structural additions exceeding drift_threshold) is surfaced up front as a warn-only advisory pointing to /gsd:map-codebase; it never blocks planning and never spawns the mapper agent. Separate from schema_drift_gate so autonomous/CI runs can silence the plan-time advisory while keeping the execute:wave:post gates enabled.

workflow.research.x-description: Run phase research before planning when research artifacts are missing or explicitly refreshed.

workflow.research_before_questions.title: Research Before Questions
workflow.research_before_questions.x-description: Run research before the interactive question round in discuss-phase.

workflow.schema_drift_gate.title: Schema Drift Gate
workflow.schema_drift_gate.x-description: Enable the drift gates at execute:wave:post. When enabled, the schema drift gate blocks verification if schema-relevant files changed during execution but no database push command was executed; the codebase drift gate (non-blocking) warns when structural additions exceed the drift_threshold.

workflow.schema_push_detection.title: Schema Push Detection
workflow.schema_push_detection.x-description: Enable ORM schema push detection during planning. When schema-relevant files are detected in the phase scope, a [BLOCKING] push task is injected into the plan.

workflow.security_asvs_level.title: Security Asvs Level
workflow.security_asvs_level.x-description: OWASP ASVS level used by security review guidance.

workflow.security_block_on.title: Security Block On
workflow.security_block_on.x-description: Minimum open threat severity that blocks advancement.

critical.x-description: Block phase completion only when critical security findings remain open.

high.x-description: Block phase completion for unresolved high or critical security findings.

medium.x-description: Block phase completion for unresolved medium, high, or critical security findings.

low.x-description: Block phase completion for any unresolved security finding, including low severity.

none.x-description: Do not block phase completion on security findings; report them as advisory follow-up instead.

workflow.security_enforcement.title: Security Enforcement
workflow.security_enforcement.x-description: Enable security threat-mitigation verification before phase advancement.

workflow.subagent_timeout.title: Subagent Timeout
workflow.subagent_timeout.x-description: Timeout in milliseconds for parallel subagent tasks (e.g. codebase mapping).

workflow.tdd_mode.title: Tdd Mode
workflow.tdd_mode.x-description: Enable TDD mode: planner annotates eligible tasks type:tdd and executor enforces RED/GREEN/REFACTOR gate sequence.

workflow.test_command.title: Test Command
workflow.test_command.x-description: Custom shell command run as the regression/test gate; auto-detected (Makefile, package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml) when unset.

workflow.text_mode.title: Text Mode
workflow.text_mode.x-description: Use plain-text numbered lists instead of interactive menus for all prompts.

workflow.ui_phase.title: Ui Phase
workflow.ui_phase.x-description: Enable the UI design-contract gate during planning.

workflow.ui_safety_gate.title: Ui Safety Gate
workflow.ui_safety_gate.x-description: Block execution on unmet UI-SPEC contracts.

workflow.use_worktrees.title: Use Worktrees
workflow.use_worktrees.x-description: Run executor agents in isolated git worktrees instead of sequentially on the main working tree.

workflow.verifier.title: Verifier
workflow.verifier.x-description: Run the verifier agent after execution to confirm the phase's goals were met.

workflow.worktree_skip_hooks.title: Worktree Skip Hooks
workflow.worktree_skip_hooks.x-description: Skip git hooks when creating or operating on executor worktrees.
